submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"

finding.headline: "The One-Handed Eater"
finding.problem: "Everything needs two hands and a knife. I'm holding a baby. If it drips on him I feel like a terrible mother. I live on biscuits."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 26-yr-old diaspora mum in Manchester, babywearing her 5-wk-old, who needs food she can eat with one hand without dripping on the baby's head — built from African staples (moi moi, akara, plantain, meat pies).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / flagship — "The One-Handed Mama's Cookbook (African Staples Edition)."". Verdict: PASSES (18/25)..
